headline: NguyenThanhNhan enters ARC-2 gold as line rises

sections.text: NguyenThanhNhan gained 3.20 to move from 19th to 16th at 69.17, taking the last of the 16 public gold places.
The gold line rose 0.42 in the past day. ARC Raiders fell from 16th to 17th at 68.75, 0.42 short of the cutoff.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
